observation.command:
cd /workspace
echo "===== 1. UI serves (GET /) ====="
curl -s -o /tmp/root.html -w 'GET / -> HTTP %{http_code}, bytes=%{size_download}, content-type=%{content_type}\n' http://localhost:3000/
head -c 200 /tmp/root.html; echo; echo "... (title tag):"; grep -oiE '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/root.html | head -1
echo
echo "===== 2. Full mock-auth dev flow (the local-builder core) ====="
rm -f /tmp/cj2.txt
echo "--- /auth/login (expect 302 -> /?auth=dev-login) ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -D - http://localhost:3000/auth/login | grep -iE '^(HTTP|location)'
echo "--- POST /auth/dev-login (create session) ---"
curl -s -c /tmp/cj2.txt -o /dev/null -w 'dev-login -> HTTP %{http_code}\n' -H 'X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest' -H 'Origin: http://localhost:3000' -X POST http://localhost:3000/auth/dev-login
echo "--- GET /auth/me (with session) ---"
curl -s -b /tmp/cj2.txt -w '\n-> HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/auth/me
echo "--- GET /api/v1/iam/me/context (with session) ---"
curl -s -b /tmp/cj2.txt -w '\n-> HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/api/v1/iam/me/context | head -c 400; echo
